test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A game in which no one wins
solution:
The correct answer is __**Draw**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The use of one word in place of a wordy phrase to clarify the sentence structure is known as** one word substitution.**
 
• The word **draw **is a noun which** **means a game or contest that ends with the even score.
 
• *Example *: The game was considered **draw **due to equal score.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **hung **is an adjective which means Emotionally befuddled or disturbed.

*Example *: People get **hung** up in a variety of ways.

 
• The word **null **is an adjective which means having 0 value

*Example *: This equation can be considered as **null**.

 
• The word **Lapse **is an adjective which means a pause or passage of time.

*Example* : There is a **lapse** of 15 minutes between this and next event.
